mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity discount rates, increasing present value of future cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS on 20-day returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or correlation with returns is not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% over three months signals labor market deterioration, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns within five trading days.
failure_condition: In triggered instances, 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a broad economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced investment and consumer spending.
failure_condition: Interaction term (INDPRO * HOUST) has Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year window, or 60-day returns positive in >60% of joint decline cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a monthly decline in retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, triggered declines yield positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPIAUCSL increase above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening and negative S&P 500 returns within five trading days.
failure_condition: Triggered inflation spikes yield positive 5-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 100,000 signals labor market contraction, reducing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Triggered payroll declines yield positive 60-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 5% signals housing sector weakness, reducing construction activity and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Triggered housing declines yield positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 1% signals industrial sector contraction, reducing corporate investment and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Triggered industrial declines yield positive 60-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
